messages:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for service inference-api -> 5% traffic, version v2.4.1-hotfix, region eu-west. change_window 02:00-03:00 UTC. Deploy ID: deploy-1748801234
Andrea: holding — seeing embedding drift on canary subset, avg cosine similarity down ~0.12 vs baseline. https://metrics/redwood/emb-drift
Sam: looking at traces/logs now, will attach heatmap and tail logs in a sec
Sam: quick note — small uptick in 502s from edge-proxy eu-west-1, origin still healthy
Maria: can we pin EU traffic back to v2.4.0 while we investigate? prefer not to do a full rollback if we can avoid it
Ops Lead: rollback readiness: command ready `redwoodctl rollout undo --deploy=deploy-1748801234 --to=2.4.0`. Warm nodes available across eu-west pool
Kevin: release notes missing KV-cache patch and a note about tokenization tweak — will update once we decide stop/go
Andrea: proposal: pause rollout, set canary to 0%, keep global routing at v2.4.0, collect traces + evals for 30m
deploy-bot: Pausing rollout... applying traffic split: 0% -> v2.4.1-hotfix, 100% -> v2.4.0
Maria: thanks. @QA can you run the failing prompt set against v2.4.1-hotfix in the canary namespace?
QA: running tests now, ETA ~18m — will post results
Sam: capturing tail logs and heap snapshots, tagging @Infra for KV cache metrics
Infra: got it — enabling extra retention for canary logs, will stream to the incident channel
Ops Lead: consensus: hold. No further traffic shifts until QA + embedding validation pass :thumbsup:
Kevin: I'll update release notes and add explicit rollback steps to the changelog and the deploy ticket
Andrea: temporary mitigation in case of repeat: enable prefix-KV cache bypass for hot prompts (`kv_bypass: true`) on canary nodes
deploy-bot: Deploy paused and traffic pinned to v2.4.0. Deploy ID locked for investigation.
